column1: # Polish (pl) catalog. Format: see the header of ja.tsv
# (context <TAB> source <TAB> translation; @id, @plural and other contexts; escapes \n \t \\).
# Plural forms (see `plural_pl` in i18n/mod.rs): one (1) | few (2–4, 22–24 ... but not 12–14) |
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label using ordinary
# Polish computing vocabulary. No proprietary localisation resource, string table or product UI
# (Acrobat's included) was consulted or copied; add entries the same way.
# Conventions: commands and buttons in the imperative (Zapisz, Otwórz…), menus and panels as nouns,
# sentence case, messages impersonal (the user is never addressed with a gendered verb form). Plain
# strings with a count use "label: {n}", since Polish nouns agree with the number; @plural entries
# carry the three forms. Terminology: comments are "komentarze", bookmarks "zakładki", links
# "łącza", tags "znaczniki", redaction "utajnienie", form fields "pola formularza", milestones
# "etapy". Product and technology names (PdfCraft, PDF, JavaScript ...) are not translated; the
# trailing "…" of dialog commands is kept.

column2: Form fields must be in the tag tree (Form tags) to be announced. Tag the form fields.

column3: Komórki tabeli muszą należeć do wiersza. Popraw znaczniki tabeli.

column3: Komórki nagłówka (TH) informują słuchaczy, co zawiera każda kolumna lub wiersz. Oznacz komórki nagłówka.

column2: A summary describes the table's purpose and layout. Add a Summary attribute to each table.
column3: Podsumowanie opisuje przeznaczenie i układ tabeli. Dodaj atrybut Summary do każdej tabeli.
